sources.title: InternVL - KerasFormers
sources.snippet: OpenGVLab's InternVL3 vision-language models, ported to pure Keras 3. An InternViT tower feeds a pixel-shuffle downsampler and an MLP connector into an inlined Qwen2 text decoder. Images are tiled dynamically: the processor picks an aspect-ratio-matched tile grid (min_patches.. max_patches) plus an optional thumbnail, and each tile becomes image_seq_length tokens.

sources.title: InternVL3-78B: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview InternVL3-78B is a multimodal large language model developed by OpenGVLab that combines vision and language capabilities in a single 78-billion parameter system. The model uses a "ViT-MLP-LLM" architecture that pairs a 6B InternViT vision encoder with Qwen2.5-72B as the language component, connected through a randomly initialized MLP projector.
